description: Delete a kanban column by ID, including all tasks in it. Get the ID and check which tasks will be removed with `list_tasks`. An already absent column also returns success.

access_key.description: Board key for direct MCP clients that handle credentials outside chat. Accepts an 8-character key or a legacy 6-character key. Keep the key out of chat and use the browser or an MCP client configured with the X-Board-Key header.
